title: Q4
description:
Read: Exo 29:1, Exo 29:19-21, Exo 29:37

Blood on ear, thumb, and toe, and blood sprinkled, sets a man apart. Whatever touches the altar becomes holy.

a) Sanctified by the offering of the body, once. Which of those acts is the sanctifying, and what does once do to a rite that set men apart and then sent them back to serve every day?
